_comment: Normalized GOLD task specifications for the generic-interface EVisiTor model. Source of truth for generate_task_models.py. Subtask terminators (end/endsub) are added by the generator. Action vocabulary: Goto, Move, Select, Type, Press, RightClick, Scroll, ClickDown, ClickUp. Decomposition rule (2026-07-11): one subtask per vendor reasoning step (or per event-stream step group when reasoning_steps are empty), following the DEMONSTRATED method — not the modeler's preferred method. RightClick acts at the current cursor position (like Select); Scroll's object is a direction (down/up); drag = ClickDown -> Move -> ClickUp. Labels in verify_uia must be checked against the live UIA tree before a live run. W05/W06/W08 were removed 2026-07-11: their reasoning steps under-specify the demonstration (see gold_task_chunks.lisp header). W07 (ipconfig_command_prompt) removed 2026-07-13: the Command Prompt / Windows Terminal output text (incl. 'IPv4 Address') is not exposed via UIA (0 text elements), so the UIA-based visicon cannot surface the target — the task is infeasible without OCR/terminal line-extraction.
dataset: anaisleila/computer-use-data-psai (HuggingFace, MIT license, Paradigm Shift AI 2025)

tasks.name: run_notepad
tasks.instruction: Use the Run dialog (Win+R) to open Notepad on Windows.
tasks.notes: One subtask per reasoning step. Pure keyboard-command task; exercises the Press pathway with a modifier combo. 2026-07-15: the closing subtask (Goto/Select 'Close') was REMOVED from the gold — the task ends when Notepad is open; the vendor reasoning step 'Close the window once done' is post-task cleanup, not part of the instructed task.

tasks.name: rename_budget_file
tasks.instruction: Open File Explorer and rename the file 'budget.xlsx' to 'budget_2025.xlsx'.
reasoning_steps: Click on the budget.xlsx file in File Explorer.
Click on the rename icon on the top bar.
Change the name to "budget_2025.xlsx" and press Enter.
tasks.notes: One subtask per reasoning step, plus an opening subtask (2026-07-15): the vendor demonstration started with File Explorer already open, but the instruction says to use File Explorer and our runtime starts at the desktop, so subtask 1 opens File Explorer from the taskbar. START STATE (revised 2026-07-16 after live testing): File Explorer closed; Explorer set to open to the Downloads folder (HKCU Advanced\LaunchTo=3) with budget.xlsx present there, freshly modified so it sorts to the top. The original 2026-07-15 plan (budget.xlsx pinned to Quick access, visible on the Explorer Home page) does NOT work on current Windows 11 Explorer: Home shows Recent/Favorites/Shared TABS, a pinned file is hidden behind the Favorites tab, and the command-bar Rename button is DISABLED for Home tiles -- renaming needs a real folder view. Re-captured live as W02_20260716_181407. KNOWN STRATEGY GAP: the vendor edited the existing name (appended '_2025', 8 keypresses); the model's Type verb cannot express within-text editing and retypes the full name -- and because Windows inline rename pre-selects only the stem, the retyped 'budget_2025.xlsx' yields 'budget_2025.xlsx.xlsx' on disk (visible in the 2026-07-16 run).

tasks.name: new_folder_projects
tasks.instruction: Create a new folder named 'Projects' on the Desktop using File Explorer.
reasoning_steps: (reasoning_steps empty in the dataset; steps reconstructed from the event stream / video: open File Explorer, go to Desktop, right-click an empty area, choose New > Folder, type 'Projects', press Enter)
tasks.notes: 2026-07-16: gold switched from the demonstrated right-click > New > Folder path back to the Ctrl+Shift+N chord (user decision). Rationale: the right-click target is the folder view's unoccupied background, which is NOT a UIA visual item (no scan exposes a 'Desktop background' element; the empty region's only UIA text is 'This folder is empty.'), so the gold step could never be grounded in the perceived interface. With an instruction that avoids the empty-space right-click (Ctrl+Shift+N, or clicking New > Folder in the command bar), the model performs the task perfectly. 'Projects' exercises the uppercase-shift typing path. Prior note (pre-2026-07-16) kept for history: 'Desktop background' stood for the folder view's empty region and had to be aliased to 'This folder is empty.' in scoring and the live agent-resolution map.

tasks.name: zip_logs_folder
tasks.instruction: Compress the folder 'Logs' into a ZIP archive.
reasoning_steps: Select "Show more options" from the dropdown.
Select "Send to" and then click "Compressed (zipped) folder" from the dropdown.
Name the .zip file created and press Enter.
tasks.notes: One subtask per reasoning step; right-click now expressed with the RightClick verb (previous spec used Press shift+f10). Step 4 says 'Name the .zip file' but the event stream shows a single keypress — the vendor accepted the default name 'Logs.zip' with Enter, which is what the chunk encodes.

tasks.name: open_calculator_start_search
tasks.instruction: Open the Calculator via the Windows Start menu search bar.
reasoning_steps: Go to the start menu and navigate to the search bar.
tasks.notes: One subtask per reasoning step; step 3 is attention-only verification that the Calculator window opened. KNOWN GAP: the event stream shows the vendor typed a shortened query (4 keypresses) and clicked the top result, while the reasoning text says 'press Enter' — the chunk follows the reasoning text.

tasks.name: search_report_docx
tasks.instruction: File Explorer is already open. Search for a file named 'report.docx' in the Documents folder using Windows search.
reasoning_steps: (reasoning_steps empty in the dataset; steps reconstructed from the event stream / video: with File Explorer already open, open Documents, click the search box, type 'report.docx', press Enter, locate the result)
tasks.notes: The Explorer search box UIA name is 'Search Documents' when the Documents folder is open. Final subtask is attention-only: locate the result. 2026-07-15: the open-File-Explorer subtask was removed — the demonstration (and the runtime start state) has File Explorer ALREADY OPEN with the navigation pane showing Documents; the instruction now states this precondition (live re-capture required).
